newsitem.title: USA: LG&E earnings up on utility gains.
newsitem.headline: LG&E earnings up on utility gains.

text.p: LG&E Energy Corp reported a 5.1 percent increase in third quarter earnings, to $0.62 per share from $0.59 a year earlier, citing a 10.7 percent increase in earnings of its regulated utility, Louisville Gas and Electric Co.

The company said it generated record revenues of $853 million during the latest quarter, compared with $410 million in the third quarter of 1995, reflecting significant sales growth in the company's power and natural gas marketing units.
But earnings of the non-utility businesses, including LG&E Power and LG&E Natural, were flat, the company said.

LG&E said the contribution to earnings from these business units was reduced by mild weather in several regions of the country. In addition, earnings from LG&E Power were reduced by transitional expenses incurred when it assumed responsibility for operating several independent wind power projects. These costs were more than offset by the successful resolution of several pending tax issues.
The Louisville Gas earnins gains came despite unseasonably mild temperatures that lowered retail electric sales from the strong third quarter of 1995, LG&E said.

The utility's earnings were positively affected by a significant increase in bulk power sales and by improved operating performance by the utility's power generating plants, which substantially reduced the need for purchased power during the period.
